run_download_ego_per_frame: run the script to download and decompress all ReInterHand ego camera envmap per-frame data for every capture ID
download_capture_id: call the download function with a capture_id to wget and extract ego camera envmap tar.gz shards for that session
summarize_capture_id_list: summarize the capture_id_list which contains 10 ReInterHand dataset capture session identifiers
summarize_name_list: summarize the name_list dict that maps each capture ID to its corresponding shard suffix names
review_download_function: review the download function that creates directories, downloads tar.gz shards via wget, and decompresses them with tar
